sources.citation: Decker, Ken, John Muniru, Julius Dabet, Benard Abraham & Jonah Innocent. 2020. A Sociolinguistic Profile of the Kyoli (Cori) [cry] Language of Kaduna State, Nigeria. SIL Electronic Survey Report 2020-012. Dallas: SIL International. 51 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 6.2 'Phonetic inventory' (pp. 9-10) gives consonant and vowel inventories and, p.10: 'Dihoff (1976) described a tone system with six distinct tone levels. In our data, we only noted four tones. However, we did not focus on tones.' Wordlists (App. E) tone-marked. No occurrence of 'stress' or 'accent' in the document. Sec. 3 confirms the entire prior literature is Williamson & Shimizu 1968 (wordlist), Dihoff 1976, Crozier & Blench 1992 (index).
